description: Couverture réseau mobile internet FREE is a dataset listed in data.melunvaldeseine.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ARCEP. Couverture théorique du fournisseur Free sur le réseau mobile internet 4G. Données Arcep du 30 Septembre 2025 Mon réseau mobile. Coverage: Melun Val de Seine (Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Territoire, équipements, services. Its keywords are Réseau, mobile, 4G, internet, FREE. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melunvaldeseine-fr-portal.
